title: I Found a $90k Remote Code Execution Vulnerability in Google
summary: A security researcher discovered a critical Remote Code Execution vulnerability in Google's developer site (devsite) caused by insecure Flask session handling using pickle serialization, earning a $90,000 bug bounty reward.
problem_solved: Exploits insecure pickle-based session serialization in Flask applications to achieve arbitrary code execution on Google's infrastructure.
why_valuable: Demonstrates a critical vulnerability in a major tech company's platform, provides educational content for security researchers, and highlights the dangers of using pickle for session data.
